description: The calibration ruler: fifty content-diverse prompts whose only job is to wash content out of the average, so that what a positional mean retains is position. Its exact contents are part of the record — the banked positional means and residual bases were fitted over these prompts, and every corrected feature subtracts those means, so a change here changes every signature downstream without changing any argument. Pinned by digest in tests/test_prompt_sets.py.
